$comment: Shared, machine-independent presets. Never put absolute or machine-specific paths here;
those belong in your git-ignored CMakeUserPresets.json (see CMakeUserPresets.json.example).

configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.$comment: Ninja is required: C++ modules (#11) are not supported by the Makefile generators.

configurePresets.name: clang-tidy
configurePresets.description: Compilation database for clang-tidy (used by scripts/pre-push.sh).
configurePresets.$comment: Build before linting: with Ninja, CMake scans for C++ modules and the compile commands reference @<obj>.modmap files that only exist after a build.

configurePresets.name: scan-build
$comment: Must NOT set CMAKE_C_COMPILER/CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER, directly or via inherits.
scan-build injects its interceptors through CC/CXX; an explicit compiler bypasses them
and the analyzer silently reports 'No bugs found'.
